title: little red clip on birds
text: little red clip on birds. I purchased these for my Mom and her little table top tree which is about 12" tall - they are meant to be accents so I only purchased the one set - you receive a set of three.  Mom loves them.  She says they are cute, chubby little red birds.  Perfect.

product_metadata.title: The Bridge Collection Resin Cardinal Clip-On Ornaments, Set of 3 Assorted
features: Made of intricately carved and painted resin

description: Classic and inspired by nature, this cardinal ornament set will bring delight to your annual tree trimming festivities. The resin birds are intricately cast and painted for a festive look which is sure to impress. Measures 2"H x 2"L x 1.5"W. Set includes 3 assorted styles.
